title: The First Tool: Asking, Checking, Driving, Drawing and Saying How It Ended

questions.question: A tool reads std::cin and writes std::cout directly. What does that cost when testing it?
options: It cannot be tested without a person typing and watching, so the logic is better taken as stream parameters
questions.explanation: The test hands run_drive text and reads back what it wrote.

questions.question: Why are all three numbers checked before anything is driven or drawn?
options: The robot needs all three at once
Output written before a problem is found cannot be taken back: a bad third number after the picture leaves half an answer, which a script reading the output cannot tell from a result
It is a rule of C++
questions.explanation: With 'fast' for the right speed: status 2, a message on the error stream and 0 characters of output.

questions.question: A person types fast for the right speed. What does the tool do?
options: Writes right speed: not a number (allowed 0 to 2) to the error stream, nothing to the output, and returns the misused status 2
questions.explanation: The message names the value, the problem and the allowed range.

questions.question: Why does the message include the allowed range?
options: It is required by the standard
The person needs to know what would have been accepted, and a message like invalid input leaves them guessing which of three values is wrong
questions.explanation: duration: no input (allowed 0.1 to 60) is a message that can be acted on.

questions.question: A straight drive has no height. What does the picture show?
options: A single row with S and E on it, because scale_to_fit scales by the axis that has an extent
questions.explanation: A scale that divided by the height would have given not a number everywhere.

questions.question: Why is the start of the path at the bottom left of the picture and the end at the top right?
options: The robot's y grows upward and rows of text grow downward, so the picture has to flip it, and the quarter circle ends up about as wide as it is tall
questions.explanation: E was in the top row and S in the bottom row, at column 0.
